text.p: Seamico Securities said on Wednesday that it recommended investors buy shares of Berli Jucker Plc as its subsidiary Siam Snack is expected to show strong growth.

Seamico Securities said in a research report that Berli Jucker's wholly-owned Siam Snack had a few months ago introduced a new brand of potato chips in Thailand and the product was expected to do well in the local market.

It said the potato chips business, estimated to be worth 1.1 billion baht ($44 million) per year, is expected to continue growing at between 20-25 percent over the next few years, driven by shifting consumer preferences as well as new promotions brought about by both existing and new players.
"BJC's profit contribution from Siam Snack is expected to weaken this year, but a better performance can be expected in 1997," the report said.
